recipes.name: Dobladitas con Salsa Verde
ingredients: 2 1/2 Serrano or Jalapeño Peppers, adjust for heat
2 bone in, skin on chicken breasts or thighs
1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: In the bowl of a food processor, add the tomatillos, peppers, garlic, onion, and cilantro. Pulse until smooth. - 1 lb tomatillos husked and rinsed - 2 ½ Serrano or Jalapeño Peppers adjust for heat - 2 cloves garlic - ½ white onion - 1 bunch cilantro
Then, transfer the blended mixture to a small saucepan and simmer down until thick, rich, and fragrant. - For the Salsa Verde
In a saucepot, poach the chicken gently in salted water with onion over medium heat until cooked. - 2 bone in skin on chicken breasts or thighs - kosher salt to taste - ½ onion
Once tender, transfer to a heat-proof bowl and shred using forks. - For the Poached Chicken
In a saucepan over medium heat, sauté onion and garlic in oil. - ½ onion - 2 cloves garlic - olive oil to taste
Toss in the beans, then add the entire bunch of chopped cilantro. - 2 cups cooked black beans OR - 1 bunch cilantro
Let it simmer until fragrant. - For the Black Beans
Then mash or pulse in a food processor until its consistency is spreadable, but not paste-like. - For the Black Beans
Heat and lightly char the corn tortillas on the gas burner until just warm and spot-charred. - corn tortillas
Fill with a layer of beans and shredded chicken, then fold in half. - corn tortillas - For the Black Beans - For the Poached Chicken
Finally, drench the assembled dobladas in Salsa Verde. - For the Salsa Verde
Top with crema, crumbled feta (or queso fresco), and a scatter of fresh cilantro. - sour cream or crema - crumbled feta or queso fresco - fresh cilantro
